NeoDisc — a modern CD player and ripper for Windows and macOS.

| Download | Platform |
| --- | --- |
| `*_x64-setup.exe` | Windows x64 installer |
| `*_aarch64.dmg` | macOS Apple Silicon |
| `*_x64.dmg` | macOS Intel |

界面支持简体中文和英文，默认跟随系统语言。支持 CD 播放、FLAC / WAV / MP3 / AAC 抓轨、自动专辑识别、音频输出选择和抓轨历史管理。

The interface supports Simplified Chinese and English and follows the system language by default. Includes CD playback, FLAC / WAV / MP3 / AAC ripping, automatic album identification, audio output selection and rip history management.

The audio encoder is bundled. `SHA256SUMS.txt` contains download checksums.

These community builds are not developer-signed or notarized. macOS optical-drive support still needs testing on physical hardware.
